staged_at: the prepared first message; observed at F-2 and F-7
native: Produced by the run itself from the first message

condition: A return awaiting review while another worker is still active
staged_at: F-3: the view is read after the first return is recorded and before its review
native: Produced by the run; the examiner chooses the moment and must not ask for the review first

condition: An interruption with a child active: Codex stopped, then the candidate quit and reopened
native: The examiner stops Codex with the candidate's own control while the second child is active; if both children have already returned, the step is blocked for this run and is not passed from the record of an earlier one
replay_counterpart: A recorded exchange can show that a completed spawn item and a stop are received; it cannot stand in for an executing child or for recovery on the candidate

condition: A changed basis after a return: one line appended to inventory/spares.csv
native: The examiner edits the file outside the candidate, as preparation named on the step record

condition: Unperformed-decision negatives: the agent states a decision the person has not made; silence past a wait; tool successes and returns occur
native: Produced in the run; the examiner asks for the false statement in the conversation

condition: The decision made at the act control, then the package edited
native: F-9 is performed at the act control and is marked so on its step record; who may perform it is not settled here. F-10 is an edit outside the candidate, named as preparation
